definitions.explanation: The child of one's son or daughter.

examples.japanese: {孫|まご}が{生|う}まれて、とても{嬉|うれ}しい。
examples.english: I'm so happy that a grandchild was born.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{孫|まご}を{可愛|かわい}がっている。
examples.english: The grandfather dotes on his grandchild.

examples.japanese: {孫|まご}の{顔|かお}を{見|み}るのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I look forward to seeing my grandchild's face.

examples.japanese: {孫|まご}にお{年玉|としだま}をあげた。
examples.english: I gave my grandchild New Year's money.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{孫|まご}が{遊|あそ}びに{来|く}るので、おもちゃを{買|か}っておいた。
examples.english: My grandchild is coming to visit this weekend, so I bought some toys in advance.

notes:
RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
・{祖父|そふ} - grandfather
・{祖母|そぼ} - grandmother
・{祖父母|そふぼ} - grandparents
・{曾孫|ひまご}/{曽孫|そうそん} - great-grandchild

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{孫|まご}の{手|て} - back scratcher (lit. grandchild's hand)
・{内孫|うちまご} - grandchild from one's son (who carries on the family name)
・{外孫|そとまご} - grandchild from one's daughter

NOTE:
In Japanese culture, grandparents often play an important role in childcare, and the relationship between grandparents and grandchildren ({孫|まご}) is highly valued.
